definitions.explanation: A reservation made on the same day it is to be used, as opposed to booking in advance. Common for restaurants, hotels, medical appointments, and event tickets.

examples.japanese: {当日予約|とうじつよやく}はできますか。
examples.english: Can I make a same-day reservation?

examples.japanese: この{旅館|りょかん}は{当日予約|とうじつよやく}を{受|う}け{付|つ}けていない。
examples.english: This inn doesn't accept same-day reservations.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}のレストランは{当日予約|とうじつよやく}だと{席|せき}が{取|と}れないことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: At popular restaurants, you often can't get a table with a same-day reservation.

notes:
Combines {当日|とうじつ} (that day, the day itself) and {予約|よやく} (reservation). A practical compound used frequently in daily life, travel, and service industries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当日予約|とうじつよやく}が{可能|かのう}: same-day reservation possible
- {当日予約|とうじつよやく}{不可|ふか}: no same-day reservations
- {当日予約|とうじつよやく}を{受|う}け{付|つ}ける: to accept same-day reservations
- {当日予約|とうじつよやく}{割引|わりびき}: same-day booking discount

CONTRASTING TERMS:
- {事前予約|じぜんよやく}: advance reservation — booking made ahead of time
- {前日予約|ぜんじつよやく}: day-before reservation — booking made one day prior
- {飛|と}び{込|こ}み: walk-in — arriving without any reservation at all
